english: as like as two peas in a pod
also: like two peas in a pod

terms.latin: tam similis quam lacte lactī est
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 2.2.85: tam similem quam lacte lactī est (Lewis & Short s.v. lac)
terms.comment: Literally “as like as milk to milk”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
